claim: The sealed premise is false: movielens-live-report-partial-evidence.test.js is not slow. It passes in 494ms inside a gate-located worktree under the repo harness (run-test-files.js, which registers @tapjs/mock/import). The observed ~40s SIGALRM was a measurement artifact of running the file bare, where the download-movielens mocks never intercept and a real live run starts. The actual publish-gate blocker is unrelated to timing: git worktree add carries no gitignored content, so data/examples/movielens-100k/u.data is absent in the gate worktree and the two dataset-reading tests fail their existsSync guard.

note: The sealed doneWhen targets a timeout that does not exist, so this Quest cannot be measured to completion without moving goalposts in place. The real defect is gate environment seeding: the publish worktree lacks the gitignored MovieLens dataset that CI fetches digest-pinned before its own gate. That correction is a one-patch mechanical fix mirroring the existing node_modules link, proven red-to-green at both unit and worktree level, so it lands directly per AGENTS.md's mechanical-fix allowance. Parking this Quest exhausted rather than resealing it.

reason: Premise disproven: the test completes in 494ms under the repo harness in a gate-located worktree; the ~40s SIGALRM was an artifact of running it bare without the mock loader. The sealed doneWhen therefore measures a non-existent defect and the honest terminal is exhausted, not a reseal.
